name: UBNET Business
summary: The UBNET Business page for registering a free business name. No public source repository was found. It stays at Level 2 because it loads the UBNet SDK, 26 scripts, from my.eth-ub.net with no integrity hash when it opens: code the server can change at any time.

connections.note: Ethereum RPC read without a light client, called when the page opens.
